_synthetic: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA. Every person, school, district, provider and message in this file is fictional and was written for this repository. No real child, family, school, district or employee is described. Nothing here is a record of anything that happened.
description: The parent's running quick-log, one entry per note. Written the way a parent actually keeps one: fragmentary, lowercase, inconsistent date formats, sourced from asking an eight-year-old what happened, and therefore hedged. It contains one self-correction, because a log that never corrects itself is not a real log. For most of the December-January speech vacancy this is the only dated record that any session was missed - which is exactly why parent_observed is a distinct evidence grade rather than a footnote.
